title: Software Engineer (Mobile SDK, Android)
org_linkedin_slogan: Better data. Better insights. Better outcomes.
org_linkedin_description: Ookla delivers unmatched connectivity insights, empowering organizations to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and deliver better connectivity for all.
ai_core_responsibilities: Design, implement, test, document, deploy, and support network measurement features for the CQoE and Speedtest Android SDKs, including debugging and contributing to the shared C++ engine across the JNI/NDK boundary. Own feature delivery end to end, use AI-assisted tools responsibly, and roll out changes with quality checks, feature flags, and post-release verification.
ai_requirements_summary: Requires at least five years of software development experience, strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, and design patterns, and substantial experience building and maintaining SDKs or libraries with Android, Kotlin, and Java. Candidates should also be skilled in SQL and Python-based data analysis, debugging, and data-quality monitoring; telecom or network measurement, iOS, networking, and embedded C++ experience are advantageous.
description_text:
The Opportunity:
We are looking for a highly capable Senior Android Engineer to join our Powered team and take ownership of our Android SDKs: the CQoE SDK, which telecom carriers and partners embed directly into their own apps to passively measure real-world network quality, and the Speedtest SDK, the core measurement library that powers every Speedtest client.
You will be responsible for implementing and maintaining features that perform a wide variety of network measurements on millions of Android devices. Much of this measurement logic lives in a shared C++ engine used across Android, iOS, and embedded targets, so you’ll have an opportunity to work across the Kotlin/Java, JNI/NDK, C++ boundary.
You love to code and appreciate well-designed APIs, as you will need to strike the right balance between SDK and application code. You have experience with Android platform, but are interested in both Android and iOS as well as embedded environments. You want to make a better Internet for everyone. If you already use Ookla’s tools to check your broadband or mobile data performance, now you have a chance to be a part of the team that produces them.

Key Responsibilities: 
Design, implement, and maintain network measurement features in the CQoE and Speedtest Android SDKs, consumed by external carrier partners, third-party app developers, and internal client apps. This includes implementation, testing, documentation, deployment, and development support
Work across the JNI/NDK boundary into the shared C++ measurement engine used across Android, iOS, and embedded targets by debugging native code and, over time, contributing to and maintaining it directly
Bring AI-assisted tooling into coding, QA, and data analysis where it genuinely earns its place, with clear guardrails around safety, privacy, security, and verification
Stay hands-on where it counts (technical reviews, architecture discussions, targeted implementation) while taking ownership of delivery end-to-end on the features and fixes you drive
Roll out SDK and measurement changes deliberately: gate them behind feature flags, run quality checks, and verify post-release that real-world behavior matches intent before widening exposure
Job Requirements:
5+ years of software development experience, with a solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, and design patterns
Experience with Android using Kotlin and Java
Substantial experience building and maintaining SDKs or libraries
Strong data literacy: comfortable writing SQL to investigate production and measurement data, using Python (or similar) for analysis, and applying data-quality monitoring practices to catch anomalies before they reach partners
A curious, proactive stance toward AI and modern engineering practices
Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, data analysis skills
Strong time management skills and a self-driven work ethic
Nice to have:
Experience with telecom/network measurement, QoE/QoS systems, or RF/cellular domain knowledge
Experience with iOS
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (IP, TCP/UDP, HTTP/S, WebSocket).
Experience with embedded systems using C++
About 
Ookla, an Accenture company, is a global leader in connectivity intelligence that brings together the trusted expertise of Speedtest®, Downdetector®, Ekahau®, and RootMetrics® to deliver unmatched network and connectivity insights. By combining multi-source data with industry-leading expertise, we transform network performance metrics into strategic, actionable insights.

Our solutions empower service providers, enterprises, and governments with the critical data and insights needed to optimize networks, enhance digital experiences, and help close the digital divide. At the same time, we amplify the real-world experiences of individuals and businesses that rely on connectivity to work, learn, and communicate. From measuring and analyzing connectivity to driving industry innovation, Ookla helps the world stay connected.


About Accenture
Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 799,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $70 billion in FY25 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.


Compensation Range
Ookla provides a range for the base pay. Factors that may be used to determine your actual pay may include your specific job related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographic location. The salary compensation for this role is 50,000 to 74,500 EUR annually. Individual pay within the compensation range for this business unit specific role is determined based on a variety of factors including experience, scope of the role, capabilities to perform the role, education and training, as well as business and company performance.

ai_requirements_summary: Applicants must be fluent in Fulah, understand its linguistic structure and cultural context, and have professional experience in translation, linguistics, language teaching, editing, proofreading, or a related field. description_text:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Fulah Language Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Spain.

Help shape the next generation of artificial intelligence by applying your Fulah language expertise to the development of more accurate, natural, and culturally aware AI systems. In this fully remote freelance opportunity, you will evaluate AI-generated content, refine linguistic outputs, and help improve the quality of language models. Your work will focus on grammar, syntax, semantics, fluency, style, and cultural appropriateness, ensuring that AI communicates effectively with Fulah speakers. You will collaborate with a team working on advanced AI technologies, contributing linguistic insights that strengthen model performance across diverse applications. This role is ideal for language professionals who value precision, cultural understanding, and innovation. Your expertise will help make AI-powered communication more accessible and reliable for Fulah-speaking communities worldwide.

Accountabilities

As a Fulah Language Specialist and AI Trainer, you will apply your linguistic knowledge and cultural expertise to evaluate, annotate, and improve language data used to train and assess AI models. You will help identify language quality issues, establish reliable evaluation standards, and provide actionable feedback that supports more accurate and contextually appropriate AI-generated content.

Review, annotate, and refine Fulah-language text used in AI training and evaluation datasets. 
Evaluate AI-generated responses for grammatical accuracy, fluency, syntax, semantics, tone, style, and overall linguistic quality. 
Assess whether generated content reflects appropriate cultural context and authentic Fulah language usage. 
Identify, categorize, and document recurring linguistic errors, inconsistencies, and patterns in model outputs. 
Provide clear, detailed feedback to improve language model accuracy, naturalness, and contextual understanding. 
Collaborate with project teams to refine prompts, evaluation methodologies, annotation practices, and linguistic guidelines. 
Apply professional judgment to distinguish accurate, natural language from awkward, misleading, or culturally inappropriate outputs. 
Maintain consistent quality standards and follow project-specific instructions when reviewing and annotating language data. 
Contribute linguistic insights that help improve AI applications in education, accessibility, communication, and other language-related use cases. 

Requirements

You are a highly proficient Fulah language professional with a strong understanding of linguistic structure, cultural nuance, and effective communication. You can critically assess written language, explain errors clearly, and apply consistent evaluation criteria to AI-generated content. Your professional background may include translation, linguistics, language teaching, editing, or a related field. Strong attention to detail, independent judgment, and the ability to provide constructive feedback are essential for success in this freelance project.

Fluency in Fulah, with a strong understanding of its grammar, syntax, semantics, vocabulary, and language conventions. 
Demonstrated professional experience in translation, linguistics, language teaching, editing, proofreading, or a related language-focused discipline. 
Strong written communication skills and the ability to evaluate language quality with precision. 
Knowledge of Fulah-speaking communities, cultural contexts, idiomatic expressions, and appropriate language usage. 
Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify subtle linguistic errors, inconsistencies, and unnatural phrasing. 
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to explain linguistic judgments clearly and consistently. 
Ability to work independently, follow detailed instructions, and meet project-specific quality expectations. 
Clear communication skills and the ability to provide structured, actionable feedback. 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AI training, language model evaluation, linguistic annotation, or data labeling. 
Experience training, coaching, or assessing language learners or other language professionals. 
Familiarity with prompt evaluation, structured annotation guidelines, or quality assurance processes for language data. 

Benefits

Hourly compensation ranging from $8 to $65 per hour, depending on experience, expertise, and geographic location. 
Fully remote work arrangement, with a worldwide project scope. 
Freelance contract offering flexibility in how you organize your work, subject to project requirements. 
Opportunity to contribute to the development and improvement of advanced AI technologies. 
The chance to apply your Fulah language expertise to applications supporting education, accessibility, and global communication. 
Professional exposure to AI training, language evaluation, and linguistic quality assurance. 
As this is a contractor position, company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and paid time off are not provided. 
Contractors must supply their own secure computer and maintain a stable internet connection. 

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
